description: List the Madeira trails that need a government hiking permit for a set start time and can be reserved on madeira.fun. Returns each trail's seo_slug (use it in the other tools), code (such as PR 18 or PS PR 1), name, island, official trail status, trail page and day feed links. Optional query filters by code or name, accents ignored.

query.description: Optional filter: a code such as "PR 18" or a name such as "Pico Ruivo".

name: list_permit_trails
title: List Permit Trails
